columns.name: creation_date
columns.description: Date when the user was created.

columns.name: num_badges
columns.description: Number of badges the user has earned, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_comments
columns.description: Number of comments the user has posted, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: created_post_with_score_more_than_60
columns.description: Set to 1 if the user has created at least one post with a score of more than 60; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: sum_of_favourite_count_gained_2011
columns.description: Sum of the favourite count gained by the user in 2011, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_posts_voted
columns.description: Number of posts the user has voted on, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: viewcount
columns.description: Number of times the post has been viewed.

columns.name: creation_date
columns.description: Date when the post was created.

columns.name: num_unique_users_commented
columns.description: Number of unique users who have commented on the post, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_views_above_average
columns.description: Set to 1 if the number of views on the post is above the average number of views on all posts; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: avg_score_of_comments
columns.description: the average score of comments that were added to the post

columns.name: posted_by_most_influential_user
columns.description: Set to 1 if the post was posted by users with the highest reputation, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: comment_with_the_highest_score
columns.description: the comment of the post that has the highest score, with ties broken by the ascending order of the text.
